items.source: Add the given flash storage using a generated name.
items.translation: 使用 生成名称 添加给定的闪存存储。

items.source: This interface also provides a way to add flash attributes. For a general overview of flash attributes see FlashMap. You can use RedirectAttributes to store flash attributes and they will be automatically propagated to the "output" FlashMap of the current request.
items.translation: 该接口还提供了添加闪存属性的方法。有关闪存属性的总体概述，请参阅 FlashMap。您可以使用RedirectAttributes来存储闪存属性，它们将自动传播到当前请求的“输出”FlashMap 中。

items.source:
A RedirectAttributes model is empty when the method is called and is never
used unless the method returns a redirect view name or a RedirectView.
items.translation: RedirectAttributes 模型在方法调用时为空，除非该方法返回重定向视图名称或 RedirectView，否则该模型永远不会被使用。

items.source:
After the redirect, flash attributes are automatically added to the model
of the controller that serves the target URL.
items.translation: 重定向后，Flash 属性会自动添加到目标 URL 的控制器模型中。
